newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Flemings starts Cresud as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Flemings starts Cresud as hold.

text.p: -- Flemings said it started coverage of Argentina's Cresud with a hold rating.
-- Flemings estimates Cresud, Argentina's only listed agribusiness and controlled by George Soros, is trading at a 17 percent to 31 percent premium to net asset value.
-- "Cresud has fallen by 25.9 percent from its recent peak of $2.24 per share, and we are therefore initiating coverage with a Hold."
-- Flemings said it believed the stock was fully valued at current levels.
-- It said Argentina's farm sector potential and Cresud's management made it a "compelling combination."
-- Flemings expects Cresud to start a sustained period of growth on higher commodity prices and lower subsidies and trade barriers worldwide.
-- It suggests investors build positions targeting a price between $1.30-1.40 per share.
